_origin: Adapted from a public postmortem; names, times and numbers changed.

incident.title: KubernetesNodesNotReady
incident.description: Kubernetes nodes NotReady since 06:01 UTC, first in us-east-1 (main cloud provider); ingestion and API error rates above 50%.

initial_context: Shown before any check. There is a change freeze this week: no application deploys in the last 40 hours. At 05:58 UTC our main cloud provider's status page posted 'Degraded network connectivity for some instances in us-east' (investigating). Our 4 regions run on 3 cloud providers (2 regions on the main provider, 1 each on the other two). Scheduled overnight: cluster certificate rotation job at 05:30 UTC; node OS images are maintained by the platform team.

hypotheses.provider: A cloud provider outage is taking our nodes down.
hypotheses.host_update: Something changed on the nodes themselves.
hypotheses.certificates: Rotated or expired cluster certificates stop nodes from talking to the control plane.
hypotheses.network_plugin: The container network plugin broke pod networking.
hypotheses.control_plane: The Kubernetes control plane is overloaded and marking healthy nodes NotReady.

failures_by_provider.description: Share of nodes NotReady, by region and cloud provider, over time.
failures_by_provider.result: All 4 regions on all 3 providers fail: 06:00 0-1% NotReady; 06:04 38-44%; 06:10 57-63%. us-east-1 was first by 40 seconds. The main provider's notice was updated at 06:20: 'resolved at 06:12; affected under 1% of instances in one zone.' Our unaffected nodes in that zone are healthy, and the other two providers report no incidents.

node_timeline.description: When affected nodes lost connectivity, and which nodes were not affected.
node_timeline.result: Affected nodes lost pod-to-pod connectivity at scattered times between 06:00:40 and 06:58:10. Nodes created after 06:00 are healthy. Every affected node was running before 06:00 and runs the Ubuntu 22.04 image; nodes on the older 20.04 image: 0 affected.

node_journal.description: systemd journal from 3 affected nodes around the time each lost connectivity.
node_journal.result: node a: 06:03:12 unattended-upgrades: Installing systemd 249.11-0ubuntu3.12 (security). 06:03:19 systemd-networkd restarted. 06:03:19 systemd-networkd: removing foreign routes on eth0 (14 routes). 06:03:20 kubelet: pod network unreachable. Nodes b and c: the same sequence at 06:21 and 06:47.

package_history.description: Automatic package updates applied across the fleet in the last 24 hours.
package_history.result: security-updates channel (enabled on the Ubuntu 22.04 image, window 06:00-07:00 UTC with random delay): systemd security release installed on 61% of nodes between 06:00 and 06:58. No other package changes.

cert_status.description: Cluster certificate validity and the 05:30 rotation job.
cert_status.result: Rotation job finished 05:34 UTC, success on all 4 clusters. kubelet client certificates valid until 2027-03-02. Unaffected nodes use the same certificates and are healthy. No TLS handshake errors in control plane logs.

network_plugin_status.description: Container network plugin version, config and agent state.
network_plugin_status.result: Plugin version 1.15.6 on all nodes since 2026-08-11; config unchanged since 2026-08-11. On affected nodes the agent is running and logs 'route to pod CIDR missing, re-adding' after 06:00, but the routes are removed again when networking restarts.

control_plane_health.description: API server latency and etcd health in each cluster.
control_plane_health.result: API server p99 latency 310ms at 06:10 (normal 120ms, rising as thousands of pods reschedule). etcd healthy, leader stable. Nodes marked NotReady had stopped posting status: their kubelets could not reach the API server over the pod network.

node_syslog_search.description: Central syslog search on affected nodes, 06:00-06:30 UTC.
node_syslog_search.result: QUERY FAILED: log search timed out after 30s (the log shippers run on the affected nodes). 0 lines returned. This is a failed query, not an empty result.

marketing_site.result: Up; hosted by an external provider. A new pricing page went live at 05:45 UTC.

backup_jobs.result: Nightly backups finished 04:12 UTC on all clusters. Verification restore passed.

on_call_roster.result: Primary and secondary on-call acknowledged pages at 06:07 UTC. Handover to the EU team scheduled at 08:00.

guidance: A failed query (like a timeout or a locked table) means the check itself could not complete. It is not evidence that nothing happened. An empty result from a wrong service name means the query was malformed, not that there is nothing to find. Neither should be cited as evidence in a root cause analysis.
